note: Four 6:45 PM Monday home games compared with four nearby non-home-game Mondays from 6–11 PM.
limitations: The 311 bounding box and 700-meter dispatch circle are similar but not identical catchments.
The May 26 control is Memorial Day and may not represent a typical Monday.
The counts are a frozen 2026-07-26 snapshot; live datasets and the game schedule may later change.

series.query: SELECT date_trunc_ymd(requested_datetime) AS day, service_name, source, count(*) AS n WHERE requested_datetime >= '2025-04-01T00:00:00' AND requested_datetime < '2025-06-01T00:00:00' AND date_extract_dow(requested_datetime) = 1 AND date_extract_hh(requested_datetime) BETWEEN 18 AND 22 AND lat BETWEEN 37.7723 AND 37.7849 AND long BETWEEN -122.3973 AND -122.3813 GROUP BY day, service_name, source ORDER BY day, n DESC LIMIT 5000
series.countMethod: Sum n across every grouped row for each date.

series.query: SELECT date_trunc_ymd(received_datetime) AS day, call_type_final_desc, agency, onview_flag, count(*) AS n WHERE received_datetime >= '2025-04-01T00:00:00' AND received_datetime < '2025-06-01T00:00:00' AND date_extract_dow(received_datetime) = 1 AND date_extract_hh(received_datetime) BETWEEN 18 AND 22 AND within_circle(intersection_point, 37.7786, -122.3893, 700) GROUP BY day, call_type_final_desc, agency, onview_flag ORDER BY day, n DESC LIMIT 5000
series.countMethod: Sum n across every grouped row for each date.
